injection_risks.description: The `ldflagsArgs` string is constructed using user-controlled input (`version`, `GO_VERSION`, `buildTime`, and `gitCommit`) which could potentially lead to command injection attacks if not properly sanitized.
The `imageTags` slice is constructed using user-controlled input which could potentially lead to command injection attacks if not properly sanitized when used in the `PublishImage` function.
